description: Durable memory that maintains itself. Notes and skills relevant to what you just said are surfaced at the start of every turn, and when a conversation goes quiet a background agent reviews it and writes down anything worth keeping. Everything is ordinary markdown in your workspace — notes in memory/notes/, agentskills.io skills in memory/skills/ — so you can read and edit it yourself. Brings the text-indexing and search chain it retrieves through, including the embedding model.
name: Memory
